title: GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline
goal: Implement automated CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions to run linting, tests, and build verification on every commit and pull request.

sub_tasks.title: Configure Lint Job
sub_tasks.output: Added TypeScript linting step to catch code quality issues

sub_tasks.title: Configure Test Job
sub_tasks.output: Added Vitest test execution with Node.js 20 LTS

sub_tasks.title: Configure Build Job
sub_tasks.output: Added TypeScript compilation check to ensure production build succeeds

sub_tasks.title: Set Trigger Conditions
sub_tasks.output: Pipeline triggers on push to main/master and all pull requests

acceptance_criteria: Workflow triggers on push to main/master branches
Workflow triggers on all pull requests
Lint job runs and fails on code quality issues
Fast feedback loop (< 5 minutes for full pipeline)
Clear job names and status reporting
result_summary: Automated CI/CD pipeline operational with GitHub Actions. Every commit and PR automatically runs through lint, test, and build stages. Catches code quality issues, test failures, and build errors before merge. Ensures main branch stability and production readiness. backend-ci.yml workflow provides fast feedback to developers.
